certifiedResults.title: North Dakota SOS All Statewide CSV export
certifiedResults.detail: Presidential county totals are parsed from the official North Dakota Secretary of State All Statewide CSV export for the 2024 general election.
certifiedResults.sourceTimestampBasis: Official SOS export generated by scripted ASP.NET postback; the page does not expose a durable file Last-Modified timestamp.

wardDetail.title: North Dakota SOS county rows for statewide contests
wardDetail.detail: The same official CSV includes county rows for President and U.S. Senate. The app converts those county rows into the review graph schema for statewide President-vs-Senate comparison.
wardDetail.sourceTimestampBasis: Official SOS export generated by scripted ASP.NET postback; the page does not expose a durable file Last-Modified timestamp.

turnout.title: North Dakota SOS voter turnout details
turnout.detail: The official turnout details page lists county turnout percentages and precinct ballots-cast rows. The importer sums precinct ballots by county and derives eligible-voter denominators from the displayed county turnout percentages.
turnout.sourceTimestampBasis: Official SOS page snapshot downloaded by the state builder; the page does not expose a durable file Last-Modified timestamp.
